pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Do Not Invent Prior Conversational History
lesson.when: Responding to a customer referencing past offline or unrecorded communications
lesson.do: Answer based strictly on available tool results and verified records without inventing specific prior conversation details or model choices
lesson.otherwise: State clearly that past conversation details are not recorded in the system instead of assuming prior discussion facts
triggers: người nhà đồng ý đổi máy
